title: Every Frame Is Code
goal: Convince a technical audience that a local, deterministic motion studio can replace a cloud render farm for short-form brand films.

scenes.headline: Every frame is code.
scenes.subhead: A deterministic motion studio that runs on your machine.
scenes.narration: Every frame you are about to see is code.

scenes.headline: Nothing is filmed.
scenes.subhead: Geometry, light and type are generated per frame.
scenes.narration: Nothing is filmed. Geometry, light and type are generated for every frame.

scenes.headline: Same input. Same pixels.
scenes.subhead: Four thousand frames, one repeatable result.
scenes.narration: The same brief produces the same pixels, every single run.

scenes.headline: No cloud.
scenes.subhead: No keys. No uploads. No render farm.
scenes.narration: No cloud, no keys, no uploads, no render farm.

scenes.headline: Bring the brief.
scenes.subhead: Leave with a film that can be audited frame by frame.
scenes.narration: Bring the brief, and leave with a film you can audit frame by frame.
